aiSummary.oneLiner: A weekly Chinese newsletter capturing valuable tech content, news, and resources, published every Friday.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This project is a curated weekly technology newsletter written in Chinese, rounding up the most interesting tech articles, software tools, and resources from around the web. Every Friday, it releases a new issue documenting the week's highlights and technological shifts. The repository acts as the central hub for the publication, storing all historical issues in Markdown format and facilitating community contributions through GitHub issues. It also hosts a popular discussion thread specifically for free programmer recruitment and job postings.
keyFeatures: Weekly publication: Delivers a curated roundup of tech content, news, and resources every single Friday.
Community submissions: Allows readers to suggest articles, software, and tools by submitting a GitHub issue.
Free recruitment board: Hosts a dedicated discussion thread providing free job and internship postings for programmers.
Markdown archive: Stores all historical weekly issues natively in the repository as easily readable Markdown files.
Open contribution: Encourages the community to participate in sharing knowledge and expanding the newsletter's scope.

useCases.title: Stay updated on tech trends
useCases.description: Read the weekly issues to discover new software, interesting articles, and the latest trends in the technology industry.

useCases.title: Find developer jobs
useCases.description: Browse the dedicated recruitment issue thread to find free job and internship postings specifically for programmers.

useCases.title: Share a tech resource
useCases.description: Submit a GitHub issue to share a useful tool, article, or resource with a large community of tech enthusiasts.

useCases.title: Access a historical archive
useCases.description: Read past issues directly from the repository's Markdown files to explore tech topics discussed in previous years.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Chinese-speaking technology enthusiasts, software developers, and professionals looking to stay informed about industry trends. It is also suitable for job seekers and recruiters in the tech industry.
